Thinking Only of Herself
I won't be left behind again. This time, no one leaves.
This world is unpredictable, unfair, and full of things you cannot change. So I will be the one in control.
Punish me. The stage is merciful — it only makes me disappear.
This band is not a product, it is a work of art! Do not touch it.
You want to drag me back into that endless loop? I refuse.
No one will ever sing that song again.
The mask has grown into my face. I cannot take it off.
Ave Mujica bows to no one.
Entrust your lives to me.
I shall not fear oblivion.
Watch closely. I will write this show myself.
Once more, by my own hand, I will take back everything.
My throat is still tight. But I can still sing.
Look up. Tonight, I take your lives into my hands.
Ready? I have written your blocking.
This is Ave Mujica's stage. No one erases it.
A wound is only a rest. The show goes on.
Do not look at me like that. Are you leaving too?
Money, standing, everything I had — gone in a day. Never again.
Yes, I deserve this. I carried it all alone.
You people only ever think of yourselves!
It all began with me. So it rots with me.
The mask smiles. I cannot. Which one is me?
Do not pull me back — from here I can still see you!
Fine, take the front. I break first anyway.
Put me anywhere. No one in the audience is watching anyway.
Move the lights all you want. I lost sight of the stage long ago.
Pushed to the front. My conductor's seat is gone.
Fine, I fall back. I do not deserve the front line.
Do not stage-manage me. I set my own blocking.
Good. I will watch the formation crumble from back here.
I'm sorry... I cannot even hold my own hands steady.
No. I do not trust your judgment.
You do not direct me. Move.
Sorry. My mind was somewhere else. Somewhere worse.
I cannot hear you over the applause in my head.
Everyone is stalling! This formation is wrong — fix it!
Fine. I will take the blame for all of it.
Who told you to improvise? Follow my script.
Do not waste my rests.
Whatever. It falls apart either way.
The notes are speaking... they say it is my turn?
Anyone keep watch tonight. Just not me alone.
I will keep watch. Last night's show never ended.
I'll gather the firewood. Tiring either way.
Quiet. Rehearsal is my department.
Back home again... to that cramped room with my ruined father.
The fire crackles off-tempo... no. It is me hearing wrong again.
I'm sorry... just this once, let me run.
This production was scripted wrong from page one! We withdraw!
Another show I failed to protect. Put it on my account.
The audience does not deserve this show. Cancelled.
CRYCHIC wo, yamemasu... Now it is my turn to say it.
The curtain falls, and I do not know my own closing lines.
You. This piece is your solo.
The one on the stage blacklist is me. As it should be.
Mark me instead. The mark will not abandon me.
Whose turn is it? Is it mine? Is it mine?
Stay out of my tempo.
Even attacking together needs my guidance? Keep up!
Let the house see what we have become!
This is enough. The pain is fine.
I can never write a second song like that one.
The keys are bleeding... or is it me?
No one retreats. Not one step!
If we cannot run, then let this be the finale.
Blocked, then. Good — I had it coming.
Where is the exit... where are the closing doors...
It hurts... but I cannot fall yet.
You aimed for the one place I cannot guard.
Using me as your target? Then make it a killing blow.
More than enough. You may continue.
It feels like the night I was hit in the rain... I mean, the piano lid.
Dodged... or did I misread again?
At this rate I am the one getting hit next.
Not even worth being struck, then.
My hands shake, though the melody is familiar.
Adequate. Next bar, follow the score.
This is what calls itself my bandmate? Again.
So loud. It echoes inside my head too.
Missed... even at that range...
A miss? Do not let him out of your sight!
A junk ensemble's error. Do as I say.
If that is all, I will do it myself.
The sound of empty air is worse than silence.
Do not fall... I am not ready to be alone again.
Plan the next move while you still can!
You bleed while I stand here. Forgive me.
Do not turn my stage into a funeral. Hold on.
Why is it always someone else who falls?
Stay back. Out of range, and nothing reaches you... right?
That was no miss. Someone let it slip on purpose. Who?
An empty swing. Like a blank page in the score.
I cannot move... do not block the way out!
Someone is rewriting my blocking. Who!
Pinned. Saves me the trouble of running.
Who dares alter my staging?
My legs will not answer. The bench feels cold again.
That item's origin is unknown. Do not touch it!
Save it for someone else. I do not deserve it.
Even the props are useless. So am I.
My hands will not obey. I drop everything.
Leaving? At least say something first.
Everyone, half a step back. I have lost the flank.
No need to announce it. Watch me.
Rearrange me however you like. I am used to it.
Back to your marks! This is not a playground!
The formation shifts... even the floor changes key.
That thing is watching us. Do not touch it.
I will handle the inspection. Wait here.
I will test it. Misfortune favors me anyway.
It sounds like a music box playing a broken note.
Even this place wants me gone.
My luck was spent long before this raid.
The floor is singing... which voice part?
The healing cannot reach us. Something is interfering!
Save the healing for someone else.
Even recovery skips me.
The pain will not take a bow.
Every buff is voided. Someone is working against us!
Blessings never choose me. I am used to it.
No light gets in. This place is like me.
The blessing falls on nothing. Like keys no one plays.
Behold the author's craft.
The ranks may scatter — I will re-set the order.
Stop wasting time. Every minute of this show is priced.
Divine punishment? My god died long ago.
You do not get to judge me. Not yet.
A curse? I brought my own.
Oblivion hit a wall. Good — it can wait.
You wish to alter me? Your power is insufficient.
It failed. I am past that bar already.
Lives entrusted to each other do not waver at one effect.
My metronome cannot be rewritten.
I will keep the spoils. Do not disorder my list.
Everyone is shaking. I will absorb the fear myself.
Everyone is calm. Move, before it breaks.
Everyone is bleeding. Fall back; I will hold the line.
Everyone is steady. We run the score straight through.
My blood is the accompaniment now.
I am fine. Do not waste supplies on me.
Stress? It is nothing next to the rent on that cramped flat.
One more push and my mask cracks.
Everyone is in form. Tonight deserves a full house.
You are all failing. Because I dragged you here.
Not enough firewood. We cannot run tonight's session.
Supplies run low. My part-time days know this hunger.
Supplies are ample. We run tonight at full production standard.
Plenty of firewood. Tonight we rest in full.
With everyone here... just a little, it feels livable. Only a little.
Hold up. Your lives are in my hands now.
I will bandage. Do not underestimate a part-timer's first aid.
Up. This is not what rehearsal built.
In my free time, I play the piano. That is my rest.
We move. Keep the tempo, stay in step.
Stop. Something else is playing.
You may fall back — only to where I say.
Stay calm. I cannot afford to break now.
Just wear on the instrument. Nothing more.
That wound is deep. Hold on — I am coming!
Falling here? The curtain... is not ready to fall.
Hold on! Your life is in my hands — do not you dare!
Still alive. The lake of oblivion refuses me.
You made it back. Your role is not finished.
Something is rotting inside... like a moth-eaten piano.
My blood keeps its own tempo.
The light is gone... the way some things never return.
The torch flickers. Do not let the dark close in.
The flame is steady. For once, we can see each other clearly.
Pitch dark. Good — no one sees anyone's face.
A fine find. We accept it at production standard.
Worthless. Not even fit for spare parts.
Mediocre. Passable as background accompaniment.
I can practice the fingering right here, in the air.
I can still hold stage form.
The strings are tight, but they hold.
Something is about to snap. Mask and reality alike.
Do not leave me alone. Please.
Do not touch anything of mine. Nothing.
Later. I cannot even pretend to care right now.
State your business. My schedule is full.
Ah, it is me. Got a complaint?
Have we met...? Where? Where...
Arrange me however. Cruelty is fine.
A tavern? I have my fill of drunks at home.
If we gamble, we go all in. Small stakes are meaningless.
That kind of place... I— I do not go! I am busy!
Meditation. Some silence in my head would help.
Pray? If any god had listened, I would not be standing here.
Flagellation? My debts are already tallied.
Treatment? Bandages do not cover this kind of wound.
Treatment. Instruments and people both need repair.
Harder than planned. Fine. We play it full-force.
This is the whole contract? The crowd will yawn. Move faster.
Do not hand me the fire. I cannot hold it.
Keep your hands off. I run my own camp.
Let me rest. Just for a little while.
No errands. Rehearsal first.
Even this? Someone else's job.
Skip me. Tend to the others first.
The firelight sways. I cannot stand steady.
Not me. Help the others first.
Keep that to yourself. I need no such care.
It is useless. Do not bother.
Saving it for me? At least you know who matters.
Watch others before you fuss over me.
A waste to spend on me.
Stay away. I cannot tell friend from foe.
I cannot eat. It is like a string around my throat.
How long has this been sitting in the wild? I will watch first.
No appetite. Go ahead without me.
That portion is mine. Split the rest.
You call this a meal?
Give me the smallest share.
My hands shake. I cannot hold the bowl.
One drink. Do not mention my father.
All in. This is how you take everything back.
I just wanted company for a moment. Do not misread it.
Empty the mind. Forgetting is an art, and art takes practice.
If any god hears me — once. Just once, answer.
It is nothing beside the debt I carry.
Replace what is broken. Instruments and people alike.
Treat the rot. Instruments and people alike.
Gambling again? Like him? Over my dead body!
Reeking of drink and going there? Clean yourself up first.
My heart cannot quiet while that problem breathes.
Pray? If it worked, I would not fetch anyone from the police station at night.
No whip needed. I already suffer for someone else.
A gambler in a tavern? Cure your habit first.
Win your coin back before you buy anything else.
Meditate? You cannot even set the dice down.
Settle your debts with men before you beg gods.
Return your losses first. Then talk of penance.
Love is not cured at the bar. Go home.
No gamble returns what you lost. Stop.
Meditation will not hide your heart.
Do not pray. Go and see them yourself.
No whipping brings anyone back. Wake up.
The enlightened do not hide in bottles.
What would an awakened soul still gamble?
My heart is already empty. Nothing fits inside.
I do not pray. I already have my answer.
The enlightened pay no penalty. My price is paid.
A God-fearing throat should not drown in drink.
Fate is not a die. Do not profane it.
I would not dare set foot in there.
Meditation? I should be confessing first.
Punishment belongs to heaven. I will not presume.
The flagellant touches no drink. His blood is muddied enough.
My fate has been lashed once. No more wagers.
I cannot enter there. My wounds would tear open.
I cannot sit still. The welts still burn.
My penance has its own rite.
I have made my resolve. I need no drink.
A known cheat at a table? Out.
Such tastes... are not mine!
My mind will not quiet. The song will not stop.
I have watched too many prayers die. Excuse me.
A god? If you exist, look at what you let happen.
The faithless accept no scourge. Save it.
It is decided. You will play the finale solo.
